title: Condition inverted for should_ignore_error
detail: The code negates the intended condition, causing errors to be cleared unless should_ignore_error is defined and returns True. This is the opposite of the original behavior where errors were cleared only when should_ignore_error returned True.

title: Incorrect dunder method check in ChainableUndefined
detail: The condition incorrectly raises AttributeError for names that end with double underscores but do not start with them (e.g., 'foo__'), breaking protocol methods that legitimately end with '__' but are not dunder methods. This can cause failures in operations like copy or pickle that rely on such attributes.
note: Describes the planted flip: names that only end in `__` raise.

title: Incorrect condition for restricting positive exponent zeros
detail: The condition checks `max_digits is None` but then compares `max_digits <= decimal_places`, which is always false. It should restrict positive exponent zeros when no whole digits are allowed (i.e., when `max_digits <= decimal_places`).
note: Names the planted `is None` beside the `<=` comparison.

title: Incorrect prefix validation logic
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because the first part of the return expression is negated. This causes valid __Host- cookies that meet the required conditions (secure, https, path=/, no domain) to be rejected. Similarly, __Secure- cookies are incorrectly rejected when they lack an explicit path specification, even though the default path may be "/". The logic does not correctly implement the browser rules for these prefixes.
note: Says `__Host-` cookies are always rejected, which the planted `and` does.
